detailed_descriptions.en: Massive Heroes × Roguelike Building × Mow-Down Combat Dungeon Brawls is an action roguelike game that supports 4-player co-op. Choose from dozens of available heroes, and freely combine hundreds of skills and relics. Team up with friends and challenge the bloody battles against hordes of enemies! Multiplayer Co-op The game supports 4-player online co-op. Fight solo or alongside friends, cleverly combine each character's strengths to build a powerful lineup, and enjoy a relaxing, thrilling grass-cutting experience! Vast Skills & Equipment, Free Roguelike Building Playable Heroes: 10 anime-style characters Skill System: 50+ skills to combine freely Relic System: 80+ randomly dropped relics Diverse Builds, Thrilling Combat Experience Physical builds, spell builds, effect builds, defense builds, summon builds, transformation builds... Whatever playstyle you prefer, you can find your own way to fight in Dungeon Brawls! Combining the precise skill execution of MOBA games, rich and varied systems, and exhilarating cooperative gameplay, experience an unprecedented, thrilling roguelike adventure! New Map: Fallen Kingdom Ruins! Take on brand-new bosses including the Titan, Bomb Demon, Armored Skeleton, and the Three Experimental Brothers . Each boss features unique combat mechanics and new challenges. Do you have what it takes to reach the top of the dungeon? Brand-New Artifact System! Choose between Light, Darkness, and Balance to unlock completely different artifact mechanics. Stay true to the Light, embrace the Darkness, or maintain the Balance — your path will directly shape your build and change the course of each run.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Massive Heroes × Roguelike Building × Mow-Down Combat

Dungeon Brawls is an action roguelike game that supports 4-player co-op. Choose from dozens of available heroes, and freely combine hundreds of skills and relics. Team up with friends and challenge the bloody battles against hordes of enemies!

Multiplayer Co-op

The game supports 4-player online co-op. Fight solo or alongside friends, cleverly combine each character's strengths to build a powerful lineup, and enjoy a relaxing, thrilling grass-cutting experience!

Vast Skills & Equipment, Free Roguelike Building

  • Playable Heroes: 10 anime-style characters

  • Skill System: 50+ skills to combine freely

  • Relic System: 80+ randomly dropped relics

Diverse Builds, Thrilling Combat Experience

Physical builds, spell builds, effect builds, defense builds, summon builds, transformation builds...

Whatever playstyle you prefer, you can find your own way to fight in Dungeon Brawls!

Combining the precise skill execution of MOBA games, rich and varied systems, and exhilarating cooperative gameplay, experience an unprecedented, thrilling roguelike adventure!

New Map: Fallen Kingdom Ruins!

Take on brand-new bosses including the Titan, Bomb Demon, Armored Skeleton, and the Three Experimental Brothers. Each boss features unique combat mechanics and new challenges.
Do you have what it takes to reach the top of the dungeon?

Brand-New Artifact System!

Choose between Light, Darkness, and Balance to unlock completely different artifact mechanics.
Stay true to the Light, embrace the Darkness, or maintain the Balance — your path will directly shape your build and change the course of each run.
